name: positive-phrasing-refactor
body: Durable-spec refactor: comprehensive positive-phrasing pass + platform reconciliation, scope global.* and requirements.* only. Inline negative/invariant prose was rewritten to state what holds, and the genuine prohibitions were promoted to requirement-layer constraints: requirements.constraint.media-paths-library-relative (media references stay inside the resolved library's media/ tree), requirements.constraint.reserved-template-names (deck/slide/notes/body reserved, _format suffix reserved), requirements.constraint.configured-library-authoritative (the configured templates: path is the sole root; no fallback/substitution), requirements.constraint.deck-body-subset (the allowed Markdown body subset and its refusals), requirements.constraint.template-registry-integrity (template-set integrity laws). Existing constraints were rephrased positively: global.constraint.anonymous-install, global.constraint.core-unbranded, global.constraint.theme-tokens-only, global.constraint.template-library-shareable, global.constraint.markdown-yaml-content-only, global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets, global.constraint.go-static-embedded-binary, requirements.constraint.brand-not-embedded, requirements.constraint.deck-properties-unknown-keys. Platform reconciliation: no requirements node called Intel macOS/Linux a non-goal; requirements.requirement.distribution was the only node listing fewer than six targets and now names all six (darwin/arm64, darwin/amd64, windows/amd64, windows/arm64, linux/amd64, linux/arm64), consistent with supported-platforms, single-binary, github-releases and native-ci-verification. No spine edges and no feature metadata were changed, and no history/brand prose was introduced.
